To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
disk layout aware optimizations are necessary for reducing disk power, and they are effective in this regard.

(1) disk layout aware optimizations are essential to reduce disk power consumption, (2) disk layout aware optimization strategies can be designed that are successful in reducing disk power consumption without performing much (if not any) worse than conventional data locality oriented strategies, and (3) the benefits of our strategy are significant in high-end server type of environments that use a large number of disks

(1) data locality oriented optimizations are not sufficient to reduce disk power, and (2) a disk-layout aware approach that combines both code and data optimizations is necessary to achieve significant energy savings
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new optimization strategy for disk power reduction, which is orthogonal to existing hardware and operating system based approaches.
the design and evaluation of a new approach to disk power reduction that is complementary to hardware-based approaches.
the design of a disk layout aware optimization strategy for reducing disk power consumption in high-end servers and clusters that execute data-intensive scientific applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
disk layout aware application optimizations are necessary for reducing disk power consumption.
our proposed strategy can reduce the energy consumption of disk-resident data by a factor of 2.5 to 4, while increasing the execution cycles only by 1.5 to 2.
our strategy is a promising approach for minimizing disk power in large scale data intensive applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the disk layout aware optimizations are a very promising way of minimizing disk power consumption.
our approach is a good candidate to be integrated into the compiler of a high-end data-intensive system, where disk energy savings is a major design goal.
disk-resident array layout is a very important parameter in determining the energy consumption of a disk system, and that it should be considered in any energy-aware optimization strategy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
one should consider the disk layout when optimizing applications to minimize disk energy.
one needs to look beyond code transformations to reduce disk energy consumption.
disk power optimization requires a holistic approach that considers both the code and data layout.
